description: Three isolated compositions populate the blank surface of the paper. On the left side, a large white flower surrounded by an extra layer of burgundy petals blooms along with three smaller flowers of a different species. The large flower resembles a type of columbine. The upper right composition shows another small white flower and a small, pale blue bloom. The lower right image features several of these small white blossoms and two pale blue flowers. The white plants throughout the work resemble lily of the valley. Dark green leaves appear in all three compositions.
